title: Clarifying Preview and Streaming Limits for a team

question.author: member_087
question.body: Before I explain preview and streaming limits to my team, what should I verify in the official guide?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Sharing Files and Folders documentation says: Previews are generated on demand and are not stored. The desktop and mobile clients play video locally, so the 500 MB preview cap does not apply to them. The web app can preview and stream files up to 500 MB, including documents, PDFs, images, and video/audio. Files larger than 500 MB must be downloaded before viewing. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
